# HTTP API code

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_agent_rules.py from rules.yml; do not edit by hand. Implements AGT-010, AGT-011. Only rules that no CI job or linter enforces. -->

- `api/routers` MUST only parse input, call one use case, and map the result or error to a response; business rules MUST NOT appear in routers or middleware (ARC-011).
- Transport schemas (`api/schemas`) MUST be separate from domain models and MUST be mapped explicitly in one direction at the boundary; domain models MUST NOT be returned directly from an endpoint (ARC-012).
- Domain errors SHOULD be mapped to transport errors in `api/errors.py` only; contract and format rules live in 17-api-and-contracts.md (ARC-013).
- Request and response bodies MUST be pydantic v2 models with explicit types, constraints and examples; handlers MUST NOT accept or return bare `dict` (API-003).
- Domain entities MUST NOT be exposed directly; API schemas live in `api/schemas/` and are mapped to domain models (see doc 03) (API-004).
- Every operation MUST declare its auth scheme and required scope or role; no operation is public by default (API-007).
- Schemas MUST reject unknown fields on requests (`extra="forbid"` or equivalent) and MUST define maximum lengths, array sizes and numeric ranges (API-008).
- `type` MUST be a stable, absolute URI identifying the problem type and resolving to documentation; if no specific type exists, use `about:blank` only for plain HTTP semantics (API-010).
- Problem bodies MUST NOT contain stack traces, SQL, internal hostnames, secrets, prompts or personal data (RFC 9457 security guidance; see 13-data-classification-and-privacy.md) (API-011).
- Machine-readable branching MUST use an extension member `code` (stable, documented) and, for validation, an `errors` array with JSON pointer and `code`; extension members need at least three characters and start with a letter (API-012).
- The problem-details exception handler MUST live in `api/errors.py` and be the only place that maps exceptions to responses (API-014).
- List endpoints MUST paginate with a bounded `limit` (documented default and maximum) and an opaque cursor; unbounded lists MUST NOT exist (API-017).
- Long-running work MUST return 202 with a status resource rather than holding the request open beyond the API deadline (API-019).
- APIs MUST be versioned in the URL path (`/v1/`) or a documented header, chosen once org-wide (API-020).
- Consumers MUST ignore unknown response fields (tolerant reader); providers MUST NOT reuse removed field names with new meaning (API-023).
- Change `docs/api/openapi.yaml` first with `scripts/export_openapi.py`; the contract test fails on drift (API-001, API-002).
- The liveness and readiness probes are the declared unauthenticated exception (docs/FINDINGS.md F-08).
